C.transfer always reverts when given an empty recipient list, regardless of other parameters.
For a nonempty recipient list and a call target with no code, C.transfer returns true and leaves both contract balances unchanged.
transfer always reverts when the _tos array is empty, due to the require(_tos.length > 0) check.
For a non-empty _tos array with an external token contract whose transferFrom succeeds, C.transfer returns true and issues one transferFrom call to caddress per recipient.
